boxferry-website.workflow:
---
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'merge_group' }}

jobs:
  validation-plan:
    name: Validation plan
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      plan: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.plan }}
      profile: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.profile }}
      select_quality: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_quality }}
      select_lockfile_release_age: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Hold the exact candidate and trusted base policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install canonical locked Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
      - name: Plan from independently trusted policy
        id: plan
        env:
          CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci plan \
            --repository-root source --config "${CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --github-output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}" --summary "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

  quality:
    name: Format, lint, test, and build
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_quality == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Hold the exact candidate and trusted base policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install canonical locked Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
      - name: Install pinned Node.js toolchain
        uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 26.13.0
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: source/package-lock.json
      - name: Install checksum-pinned native file-quality tools
        env:
          PROFILE: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.profile }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          tool_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/boxferry-website-tools"
          if [[ "${PROFILE}" == full ]]; then
            bash source/scripts/install-file-tools.sh "${tool_dir}"
          else
            bash source/scripts/install-file-tools.sh "${tool_dir}" --lychee-only
          fi
          printf '%s\n' "${tool_dir}" >> "${GITHUB_PATH}"
      - name: Run the independently selected website tasks
        env:
          CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          BOXFERRY_WEBSITE_FORMAT_MODE: check
          BOXFERRY_WEBSITE_SOURCE_MODE: locked
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci run-local \
            --repository-root source --config "${CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --report-json "${RUNNER_TEMP}/website-validation.json" \
            --summary "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"
      - name: Retain structured website validation evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: website-validation-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/website-validation.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 7

  lockfile-release-age:
    name: Dependency eligibility
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      statuses: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-dependency-wait.yml@95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}

  pr-gate:
    name: Required CI
    if: always()
    needs: [validation-plan, quality, lockfile-release-age]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Hold the exact candidate and trusted base policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install canonical locked Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- External SHA-pinned BoxFerry checkout; $/ would select this website repository.
      - name: Require exact-candidate planned outcomes
        env:
          CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          PLAN_JSON: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.plan }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci gate \
            --repository-root source --config "${CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --plan-json "${PLAN_JSON}" --needs-json "${NEEDS_JSON}" \
            --summary "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

  publish-site:
    name: Publish validated website
    if: >-
      github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      needs.pr-gate.result == 'success'
    needs: [pr-gate]
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/deploy.yml # zizmor: ignore[self-repository] -- Same-commit reusable workflow; pinned actionlint 1.7.12 lacks $/ support.
    secrets:
      BOXFERRY_RSYNC_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.BOXFERRY_RSYNC_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
      BOXFERRY_VERSION_UPDATER_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY: ${{ secrets.BOXFERRY_VERSION_UPDATER_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
    with:
      operation: deploy
      revision: ${{ github.sha }}
      automatic: true

docker-lens.workflow:
---
name: Check

on:
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
    types: [checks_requested]
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  # Diagnostics must not cancel required main native qualification.
  group: check-${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && 'diagnostic' || 'validation' }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  hosted-prerequisite-diagnostic:
    name: Hosted prerequisite diagnostic (not native validation)
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Collect bounded read-only prerequisite observations
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          umask 077
          set -o noclobber
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=2s 55s python3 -B scripts/native-outer-runtime-profile.py > "$RUNNER_TEMP/dockerlens-hosted-prerequisite.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: dockerlens-hosted-prerequisite
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dockerlens-hosted-prerequisite.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  validation-plan:
    name: Validation plan
    if: github.event_name != 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      plan: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.plan }}
      profile: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.profile }}
      select_rust: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_rust }}
      select_msrv: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_msrv }}
      select_dependencies: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_dependencies }}
      select_api: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_api }}
      select_documentation: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_documentation }}
      select_lockfile_release_age: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact candidate and trusted policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Select checks from the trusted comparison base
        id: plan
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          POLICY_CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci plan \
            --repository-root source --config "${POLICY_CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --github-output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

  rust:
    name: Rust quality
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_rust == 'true'
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-ci.yml@95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      task: rust-quality

  msrv:
    name: Minimum supported Rust
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_msrv == 'true'
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-ci.yml@95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      task: msrv

  dependencies:
    name: Dependency and license policy
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_dependencies == 'true'
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-dependencies.yml@95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json

  api:
    name: Development public API compatibility
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_api == 'true'
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-rust-semver.yml@95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
      config_path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      package: docker-lens
      api_purpose: development
      initial_api_contract: false

  documentation:
    name: Repository policy and Python automation
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_documentation == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact candidate and trusted policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Set up exact shared CI Node
        if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.profile != 'prose'
        uses: ./source/.github/actions/setup-node
        with:
          repository-root: source
      - name: Set up canonical tools and the real Renovate engine
        if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.profile != 'prose'
        run: uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python source/scripts/setup-ci-tools.py --engine docker --node-context hosted
      - name: Check workflow syntax and the changed complete-gate shell
        if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.profile != 'prose'
        working-directory: source
        run: |
          actionlint
          shellcheck scripts/check-all.sh
          shfmt -d -i 2 -ci -sr scripts/check-all.sh
      - name: Check newly shared Python entry points
        working-directory: source
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project ../_automation/automation ruff check scripts/validation-plan.py scripts/setup-ci-tools.py tests/test_shared_automation.py
          uv run --locked --project ../_automation/automation ruff format --check scripts/setup-ci-tools.py tests/test_shared_automation.py
          uv run --locked --project ../_automation/automation ty check scripts/validation-plan.py scripts/setup-ci-tools.py
      - name: Run the repository-owned offline policy suite
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          POLICY_CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          DOCKERLENS_METADATA_UNCHANGED: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.profile == 'prose' && '1' || '0' }}
        run: |
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci run \
            --task documentation \
            --repository-root source --config "${POLICY_CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}"

  lockfile-release-age:
    name: Dependency eligibility
    needs: validation-plan
    if: needs.validation-plan.outputs.select_lockfile_release_age == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
      statuses: read
    uses: Strukturpiloten/boxferry/.github/workflows/shared-dependency-wait.yml@95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03 # automation-v1 interface v1
    with:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
      automation_sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
      policy_sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}

  native-conformance:
    name: Native Engine ${{ matrix.lane }}
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 35
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane:
          [
            debian11-rootful,
            debian11-rootless,
            upstream-rootful,
            upstream-rootless,
          ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Run isolated native lane
        env:
          DOCKERLENS_NATIVE_EVIDENCE_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/dockerlens-native-evidence
          DOCKERLENS_NATIVE_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: ./scripts/native-conformance.sh "${{ matrix.lane }}"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: dockerlens-native-${{ matrix.lane }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/dockerlens-native-evidence/${{ matrix.lane }}.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  check-gate:
    name: Required CI
    if: always() && !(github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main')
    needs:
      [
        validation-plan,
        rust,
        msrv,
        dependencies,
        api,
        documentation,
        lockfile-release-age,
        native-conformance,
      ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      candidate_sha: ${{ github.sha }}
    steps:
      - name: Check out immutable shared automation
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          repository: Strukturpiloten/boxferry
          # renovate: datasource=github-digest depName=Strukturpiloten/boxferry currentValue=automation-v1
          ref: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          path: _automation
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Bind exact candidate and trusted policy
        id: source
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-source
        with:
          candidate-sha: ${{ github.sha }}
          automation-sha: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          policy-sha: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          config-path: scripts/validation-policy.json
      - name: Install locked shared Python tooling
        uses: ./_automation/.github/actions/shared-python
      - name: Require selected jobs and only intentional skips
        id: offline
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.event.merge_group.head_sha || github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.merge_group.base_sha || github.sha }}
          AUTOMATION_SHA: 95f5514f00f0f27475f9a58d5e17d149c2983b03
          POLICY_CONFIG: ${{ steps.source.outputs.config }}
          PLAN_JSON: ${{ needs.validation-plan.outputs.plan }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: |
          NEEDS_JSON="$(python3 -c 'import json, os; needs = json.loads(os.environ["NEEDS_JSON"]); needs.pop("native-conformance"); print(json.dumps(needs))')"
          uv run --locked --project _automation/automation python -m boxferry_ci gate \
            --repository-root source --config "${POLICY_CONFIG}" \
            --event "${EVENT_NAME}" --base-sha "${BASE_SHA}" --head-sha "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            --tested-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}" --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --automation-sha "${AUTOMATION_SHA}" \
            --plan-json "${PLAN_JSON}" --needs-json "${NEEDS_JSON}"
      - name: Fail on skipped, cancelled, or failed validation
        env:
          EVENT_NAME: ${{ github.event_name }}
          EVENT_REF: ${{ github.ref }}
          SCAFFOLD_RESULT: ${{ steps.offline.outcome }}
          NATIVE_RESULT: ${{ needs.native-conformance.result }}
        run: |
          test "$SCAFFOLD_RESULT" = success
          if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == pull_request || "$EVENT_NAME" == merge_group ]]; then
            test "$NATIVE_RESULT" = skipped
            echo 'PR and queue validation is offline-only; native Engine evidence is not claimed'
          elif [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == push && "$EVENT_REF" == refs/heads/main ]]; then
            test "$NATIVE_RESULT" = success
          else
            echo 'unexpected validation event; native evidence is required' >&2
            exit 1
          fi

scope: Exact static event-excluded job presentation and source shapes only; no eligibility or automated recovery proof
